defaults.values:
# Poiesis values.yaml (non-default values only)

database:
  existingSecret: ""  # required

s3:
  region: ""  # required
  existingSecret: ""  # required

auth:
  issuers:
    - issuer: ""  # required
      audience: poiesis
      clients: [poiesis-cli]
defaults.install:
# 1. Secrets. The chart references them; it never creates them.
kubectl create namespace poiesis

kubectl -n poiesis create secret generic poiesis-db \
  --from-literal=DATABASE_URL='postgresql://poiesis:…@db:5432/poiesis?sslmode=require'

kubectl -n poiesis create secret generic poiesis-s3 \
  --from-literal=AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=… \
  --from-literal=AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=…

# 2. Install (from a checkout until the chart is published, #53)
helm install poiesis ./deployment/helm/poiesis \
  -n poiesis -f values.yaml

steps: set a public URL so clients can find the issuer

basics.title: Public URL
pts: Becomes the ingress host and auth.resource.
A client that only knows this URL gets a 401 that points to the metadata.
The metadata names your issuers, so the client can log in.

hops.label: GET /tasks
hops.cap: A client calls the public URL.

hops.label: GET /tasks
hops.cap: The ingress forwards it to the API.
No token: 401, pointing to the resource metadata.

hops.label: log in
hops.cap: The metadata names the issuer. The client logs in there.

hops.label: Bearer …
hops.cap: It retries with the token and gets 200.

db.title: Database
pts: The API and tctl read DATABASE_URL from your Secret.
A migration hook updates the schema before each install or upgrade.
In production, use sslmode=verify-full with a CA ConfigMap.

hops.label: DATABASE_URL
hops.cap: The API reads the URL from your Secret.

hops.label: DATABASE_URL
hops.cap: So does tctl, which records how tasks end.

hops.label: tasks
hops.cap: The API stores tasks and API keys.

hops.label: COMPLETE
hops.cap: tctl writes each task's final state.

storage.title: Storage
pts: Only task inputs and outputs touch object storage.
Credentials come from your Secret, or from workload identity.
While a task runs, its files live on its own volume.

hops.label: AWS_*
hops.cap: tif gets the S3 credentials.

hops.label: reads.fq
hops.cap: It downloads each input…

hops.label: reads.fq
hops.cap: …onto the task's volume.

hops.label: sorted.bam
hops.cap: After the executors, tof picks up the outputs…

hops.label: sorted.bam
hops.cap: …and uploads them.

vol.title: Task volumes
pts: Sized by the task's disk_gb, up to the largest allowed.
Shared by the task's containers.
Deleted with the Job after retainAfterSeconds.

authn.title: Authentication
pts: The token's iss must match one trusted issuer exactly. Order doesn't matter.
Signature, audience, token type and client are checked.
The owner is issuer|subject, stamped on every task.

hops.label: iss ✓
hops.cap: The token's iss matches a trusted issuer exactly.

hops.label: alice
hops.cap: Checks pass: the caller is issuer|alice.

authz.title: Authorization
pts: Everyone sees and cancels only their own tasks.
An admin group can revoke anyone's API keys.
Add a decision service later to share tasks.

hops.label: GET
hops.cap: alice asks for a task.

hops.label: owner?
hops.cap: Poiesis checks who owns the task.
It's hers: 200. Anyone else gets 404.

adv.title: Advanced
pts: None of these are needed to start.

review.title: Installing
pts: Create the Secrets first; the chart only refers to them.
A migration hook runs before the API starts.
tctl polls TaskPods and records how each task ends.

hops.label: create
hops.cap: Create the database and S3 Secrets.

hops.label: Secrets
hops.cap: They land in the namespace.

hops.label: install
hops.cap: Run helm install with your values.yaml.

hops.label: migrate
hops.cap: Migrations run, then the API and tctl start.

hops.label: ready
hops.cap: Point an engine at the public URL.

  existingSecret: poiesis-s3  # example, replace

  resource: https://poiesis.example.org  # example, replace
  issuers:
    - issuer: https://keycloak.example.org/realms/poiesis  # example, replace

      tokenTypes: [JWT]  # Keycloak access tokens; other issuers default to at+jwt
      clients: [poiesis-cli]

  --from-literal=AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=… \
  --from-literal=AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=…

  -n poiesis -f values.yaml
